name: Kimi no Shinzou to Cosmos o Miru
original_name: 君の心臓とコスモスを見る
source: In this story, three troubled high school girls. The tale then shifts to his past, where he meets his destined partner, only to face her congenital heart disease. It’s a story of how each path leads to its own form of happiness.
translation: 在这个故事中，三个陷入困境的高中女孩。故事随后转向他的过去，在那里他遇到了命中注定的伴侣，却要面对她的先天性心脏病。这是一个关于每条道路如何通向各自形式的幸福的故事。
